candidates.name: Keep SHIP_COMPANY_PLANNING only
candidates.covers: Choosing a local checkout per shell.
candidates.misses: Every person and agent must know to set it; nothing a repository carries.

candidates.name: A git submodule of Company Planning
candidates.covers: A pinned copy inside each repository.
candidates.misses: The branch being shipped controls the pinned commit, so a branch could pick its own validator; adds a private repository to public ones.
candidates.reason: The validator must not be chosen by the branch it judges.
